/* ========================================================= MAI V5 — Acesso direto a itens + modal unificado ========================================================= */ /* Hoje: cada área ocupa sua própria largura. */ .mai-today-inner { width: 100%; max-width: none !important; } .mai-today-grid { display: contents !important; } .mai-row-value { flex: 0 0 auto; margin-left: 18px; color: var(--text-primary); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 650; white-space: nowrap; } .mai-row-chevron { flex: 0 0 auto; color: var(--text-tertiary); font-size: 19px; } .mai-inline-progress { width: min(360px, 100%); height: 3px; margin-top: 7px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--divider); } .mai-inline-progress > span { display: block; height: 100%; border-radius: inherit; background: var(--warning); } /* Em breve: uma timeline longa e contínua, sem seletor de período. */ .mai-upcoming { height: 100%; overflow-y: auto !important; overscroll-behavior: contain; } .mai-upcoming-inner { width: 100%; max-width: none !important; min-height: 100%; padding-bottom: 72px !important; } .mai-upcoming-toolbar-scroll { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 20; justify-content: flex-end !important; padding-top: 10px; padding-bottom: 10px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-primary) 94%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(10px); } .mai-upcoming-list { overflow: visible !important; height: auto !important; max-height: none !important; } .mai-upcoming-day { scroll-margin-top: 64px; } .mai-upcoming-day-heading { position: sticky; top: 54px; z-index: 10; background: var(--bg-primary); } /* Modal padrão único para itens abertos a partir de Hoje / Em breve. */ .mai-entity-modal { position: fixed !important; inset: 0 !important; z-index: 20000 !important; align-items: center !important; justify-content: center !important; padding: 24px !important; background: var(--modal-overlay) !important; backdrop-filter: blur(6px) !important; } .mai-entity-modal:not(.active) { display: none !important; opacity: 0 !important; pointer-events: none !important; } .mai-entity-modal.active { display: flex !important; opacity: 1 !important; pointer-events: auto !important; } .mai-entity-modal > .t-modal-surface, .mai-entity-modal > .m-modal-surface, .mai-entity-modal > .n-modal-surface, .mai-entity-modal > .sys-modal-surface { width: min(880px, calc(100vw - 48px)) !important; max-width: 880px !important; max-height: min(88dvh, 920px) !important; margin: 0 !important; border: 1px solid var(--divider) !important; border-radius: 16px !important; background: var(--bg-card) !important; box-shadow: var(--shadow-modal) !important; overflow: hidden !important; } .mai-entity-modal[data-mai-module="metas"] > .m-modal-surface, .mai-entity-modal[data-mai-module="notas"] > .n-modal-surface, .mai-entity-modal[data-mai-module="habitos"] > .sys-modal-surface, .mai-entity-modal[data-mai-module="financas"] > .sys-modal-surface { max-width: 760px !important; } .mai-entity-modal .sys-modal-header, .mai-entity-modal .n-modal-header, .mai-entity-modal .t-modal-header, .mai-entity-modal .m-modal-header { min-height: 54px !important; padding: 12px 18px !important; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--divider) !important; background: var(--bg-card) !important; } .mai-entity-modal .sys-modal-body, .mai-entity-modal .n-modal-body { padding: 20px !important; } .mai-entity-modal .sys-btn-primary, .mai-entity-modal .mai-primary-button { border-radius: 8px !important; } @media (max-width: 820px) { .mai-entity-modal { padding: 0 !important; align-items: flex-end !important; } .mai-entity-modal > .t-modal-surface, .mai-entity-modal > .m-modal-surface, .mai-entity-modal > .n-modal-surface, .mai-entity-modal > .sys-modal-surface { width: 100vw !important; max-width: none !important; height: min(94dvh, 980px) !important; max-height: 94dvh !important; border-left: 0 !important; border-right: 0 !important; border-bottom: 0 !important; border-radius: 18px 18px 0 0 !important; } .mai-upcoming-toolbar-scroll { top: 0; justify-content: flex-start !important; overflow-x: auto; } .mai-upcoming-day-heading { top: 52px; } .mai-row-value { margin-left: 10px; font-size: 12px; } } /* Consistência visual dos popups em todos os módulos, mesmo quando abertos dentro do próprio módulo. */ .t-modal-overlay, .m-modal-overlay, .n-modal-overlay, .sys-modal-overlay { backdrop-filter: blur(6px) !important; } .t-modal-surface, .m-modal-surface, .n-modal-surface, .sys-modal-surface { border-color: var(--divider) !important; border-radius: 16px !important; background: var(--bg-card) !important; box-shadow: var(--shadow-modal) !important; } /* Saúde pode abrir seus formulários sem trocar de módulo, preservando os estilos internos escopados. */ #mod-saude.mai-modal-host { display: block !important; position: fixed !important; inset: 0 !important; z-index: 19000 !important; pointer-events: none !important; background: transparent !important; } #mod-saude.mai-modal-host #sau-container { position: fixed !important; inset: 0 !important; pointer-events: none !important; background: transparent !important; } #mod-saude.mai-modal-host #sau-container > *:not(.sys-modal-overlay) { visibility: hidden !important; pointer-events: none !important; } #mod-saude.mai-modal-host .sys-modal-overlay.active { visibility: visible !important; pointer-events: auto !important; }
